summary: Delek US Holdings completed a private offering of $460 million 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 via an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee, per this 8-K. The notes are senior unsecured, fully guaranteed by subsidiary guarantors of the term loan and ABL facilities, mature November 1, 2031, bear no regular interest, and are convertible only on specified conditions (e.g., stock at 150% of conversion price). No price, premium, or use of proceeds is disclosed; this is a financing, not a control event.
